text:
Ana: Quick brainstorm thread 15-30m webinar focused on actionable latency & cost fixes for product teams. Looking for a hook that isn't "benchmarks".
Ravi: "Playbooks not pontification"? shorter: 'Inference Playbook: 3 ops levers you can ship this sprint'.
Becca: love the sprint angle. suggests we call out a customer ROI stat in the header e.g., ">30% token cost cut in production" if we have a clean metric.
Ana: we have a sanitized figure from the Acme pilot: 32% lower token spend after batching + cache. OK to use that.
Tarek: speaker asks: who will present the bench? I'll volunteer for ops checklist if someone from product leads the narrative.
Ravi: volunteer accepted for bench narr. Becca can hunt for customer speaker (Acme Nisha?)
Becca: reached out to Nisha (Acme) she said yes to a 7min segment if we keep it conversational.
Ana: excellent. Proposed flow: 1) Hook & headline (2m) 2) Customer story (7m) 3) Playbook demo (18m) 4) 3-item checklist & CTA (5m) 5) Qs (3-5m). total ~35-40m.
EventBot: New event draft created: "Inference Playbook: 3 levers to cut token spend" - draft link https://events.redwood.example/d/abc123
Ravi: that timing works. For the demo: will show a baseline run, then apply batching, then caching, then routing to a cheaper model variant. Each step show real latency and cost delta.
Tarek: for rehearsals, propose two short run-throughs: tech check (30m) and full run (45m). windows Wed/Fri next week 09:30-11:00 PT.
Ana: book Wed 09:30 for tech check. I'll create cue cards and the audience poll question.
Becca: marketing copy notes: headline variants x3, short description (1-2 lines), TL;DR bullets, and 2 social CTAs. I'll draft by tomorrow lunch.
Ravi: also plan a 90s fallback video showing the demo output and narrated steps in case of live issues. I can record the demo CLI and screen capture.
Tarek: capture commands for reproducibility. small snippet for health check + model pin: `curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.example/v1/models/model-123/status" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
Ana: follow-up assets: slide with the 3-lever checklist (downloadable), a reproducible notebook link, and an ops-ready snippet for health checks.
Becca: we'll also include a short post-event nurture: email with recording + checklist + CTA to request a cost audit. Draft follow-up copy after rehearsal.
EventBot: Rehearsal scheduled Wed 09:30 PT; attendees: Ana, Ravi, Becca, Tarek, Nisha (tentative). Calendar invite sent.
Ana: final ask: Ravi, can you prepare two short graphs (latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens) for the demo slides?
Ravi: yes, will add PNGs to the drive and a quick narration script.
Tarek: noted. I'll prepare cue cards for the host including exact phrasing to introduce the customer.
Ana: thanks team. next sync at the tech check. We'll finalize copy + landing page after that. :rocket:
